Package com.splendor.view

Class RemoteView

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.view.RemoteView
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGameView
public class RemoteView extends Object implements IGameView
Network-based implementation of IGameView for remote clients. Sends game state and receives moves via network protocol.

    • promptForMove

      public Move promptForMove(Player player, Game game, List<MenuOption> options)
      Sends the rendered board-plus-menu to the client, then loops prompting for a valid menu selection and any required follow-up input (gem colors, card IDs, tier). Returns a default move if the client times out with no response.
      Specified by:
      promptForMove in interface IGameView
      Parameters:
      player - The player whose turn it is.
      game - The current game state (used for board rendering).
      options - The ordered list of MenuOptions to present.
      Returns:
      A fully-constructed Move ready for validation.

    • promptForTokenDiscard

      public Move promptForTokenDiscard(Player player, int excessCount)
      Sends a discard instruction to the client and parses the response into a DISCARD_TOKENS move. Falls back to a gold-first default discard if the client does not respond within 30 seconds.
      Specified by:
      promptForTokenDiscard in interface IGameView
      Parameters:
      player - The player who must discard tokens.
      excessCount - The number of tokens to discard to reach the 10-token limit.
      Returns:
      A DISCARD_TOKENS Move specifying which tokens to return to the bank.

    • promptForNobleChoice

      public Noble promptForNobleChoice(Player player, List<Noble> nobles)
      Sends a numbered noble list to the client and waits up to 30 seconds for a choice. Defaults to the first noble if the response is missing, out of range, or unparseable.
      Specified by:
      promptForNobleChoice in interface IGameView
      Parameters:
      player - The player who qualifies for a noble visit.
      nobles - The subset of nobles the player can claim (size >= 1).
      Returns:
      The chosen Noble, or nobles.get(0) as a safe fallback.

    • promptForPlayerName

      public String promptForPlayerName(int playerNumber, int totalPlayers)
      Prompts this client to enter their player name and waits up to 30 seconds. Returns a default name ("Player{N}") if the response is null or blank.
      Specified by:
      promptForPlayerName in interface IGameView
      Parameters:
      playerNumber - 1-based player number shown in the prompt.
      totalPlayers - Total number of players in the game (for context in the prompt).
      Returns:
      The trimmed name entered by the client, or "Player{playerNumber}" as fallback.
